commands.command:
cd ~/ansible/internal-time-sync
cat > site.yml <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
---
- name: Configure node1 as internal cluster time source
  hosts: time_server
  gather_facts: false
  vars:
    ansible_python_interpreter: none
  tasks:
    - name: Backup existing chrony.conf
      ansible.builtin.raw: |
        test -f /etc/chrony.conf.orig || sudo cp /etc/chrony.conf /etc/chrony.conf.orig
      changed_when: false

    - name: Install chrony.conf making this host an internal stratum source
      ansible.builtin.raw: |
        printf '%s\n' \
          '# Managed by Ansible: node1 is the internal time source for the cluster' \
          'local stratum 10' \
          'allow 10.100.29.0/24' \
          'driftfile /var/lib/chrony/drift' \
          'makestep 1.0 3' \
          'rtcsync' \
          'logdir /var/log/chrony' | sudo tee /etc/chrony.conf.new >/dev/null
        sudo mv /etc/chrony.conf.new /etc/chrony.conf
      register: node1_conf
      changed_when: true

    - name: Restart chronyd on node1
      ansible.builtin.raw: sudo systemctl restart chronyd && sudo systemctl is-active chronyd
      register: node1_restart
      changed_when: true

    - name: Show chrony tracking on node1
      ansible.builtin.raw: sudo chronyc tracking
      register: node1_tracking
      changed_when: false

    - debug:
        var: node1_tracking.stdout_lines

- name: Configure node2 to sync against node1
  hosts: time_client
  gather_facts: false
  vars:
    ansible_python_interpreter: none
  tasks:
    - name: Backup existing chrony.conf
      ansible.builtin.raw: |
        test -f /etc/chrony.conf.orig || sudo cp /etc/chrony.conf /etc/chrony.conf.orig
      changed_when: false

    - name: Install chrony.conf pointing at node1
      ansible.builtin.raw: |
        printf '%s\n' \
          '# Managed by Ansible: sync against internal time source node1' \
          'server 10.100.29.10 iburst' \
          'driftfile /var/lib/chrony/drift' \
          'makestep 1.0 3' \
          'rtcsync' \
          'logdir /var/log/chrony' | sudo tee /etc/chrony.conf.new >/dev/null
        sudo mv /etc/chrony.conf.new /etc/chrony.conf
      register: node2_conf
      changed_when: true

    - name: Restart chronyd on node2
      ansible.builtin.raw: sudo systemctl restart chronyd && sudo systemctl is-active chronyd
      register: node2_restart
      changed_when: true

    - name: Force a burst sync against node1
      ansible.builtin.raw: sudo chronyc burst 4/4; sleep 5; sudo chronyc makestep
      register: node2_burst
      changed_when: false

    - name: Show chrony sources on node2
      ansible.builtin.raw: sudo chronyc sources -v
      register: node2_sources
      changed_when: false

    - debug:
        var: node2_sources.stdout_lines
ANTRIEB_EOF
echo WRITTEN
cat site.yml | wc -l
commands.stdout:
WRITTEN
80

commands.stdout:
---
- name: Configure node1 as internal cluster time source
  hosts: time_server
  gather_facts: false
  vars:
    ansible_python_interpreter: none
  tasks:
    - name: Backup existing chrony.conf
      ansible.builtin.raw: |
        test -f /etc/chrony.conf.orig || sudo cp /etc/chrony.conf /etc/chrony.conf.orig
      changed_when: false

    - name: Install chrony.conf making this host an internal stratum source
      ansible.builtin.raw: |
        printf '%s\n' \
          '# Managed by Ansible: node1 is the internal time source for the cluster' \
          'local stratum 10' \
          'allow 10.100.29.0/24' \
          'driftfile /var/lib/chrony/drift' \
          'makestep 1.0 3' \
          'rtcsync' \
          'logdir /var/log/chrony' | sudo tee /etc/chrony.conf.new >/dev/null
        sudo mv /etc/chrony.conf.new /etc/chrony.conf
      register: node1_conf
      changed_when: true

    - name: Allow NTP service through firewalld so clients can reach this source
      ansible.builtin.raw: |
        sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-service=ntp
        sudo firewall-cmd --reload
      register: node1_fw
      changed_when: true

    - name: Restart chronyd on node1
      ansible.builtin.raw: sudo systemctl restart chronyd && sudo systemctl is-active chronyd
      register: node1_restart
      changed_when: true

    - name: Show chrony tracking on node1
      ansible.builtin.raw: sudo chronyc tracking
      register: node1_tracking
      changed_when: false

    - debug:
        var: node1_tracking.stdout_lines

- name: Configure node2 to sync against node1
  hosts: time_client
  gather_facts: false
  vars:
    ansible_python_interpreter: none
  tasks:
    - name: Backup existing chrony.conf
      ansible.builtin.raw: |
        test -f /etc/chrony.conf.orig || sudo cp /etc/chrony.conf /etc/chrony.conf.orig
      changed_when: false

    - name: Install chrony.conf pointing at node1
      ansible.builtin.raw: |
        printf '%s\n' \
          '# Managed by Ansible: sync against internal time source node1' \
          'server 10.100.29.10 iburst' \
          'driftfile /var/lib/chrony/drift' \
          'makestep 1.0 3' \
          'rtcsync' \
          'logdir /var/log/chrony' | sudo tee /etc/chrony.conf.new >/dev/null
        sudo mv /etc/chrony.conf.new /etc/chrony.conf
      register: node2_conf
      changed_when: true

    - name: Restart chronyd on node2
      ansible.builtin.raw: sudo systemctl restart chronyd && sudo systemctl is-active chronyd
      register: node2_restart
      changed_when: true

    - name: Force a burst sync against node1
      ansible.builtin.raw: sudo chronyc burst 4/4; sleep 5; sudo chronyc makestep
      register: node2_burst
      changed_when: false

    - name: Show chrony sources on node2
      ansible.builtin.raw: sudo chronyc sources -v
      register: node2_sources
      changed_when: false

    - debug:
        var: node2_sources.stdout_lines
